drafted_from: tool row in tools/wikimedia-commons/tool-rows.json (invoke http GET to commons.wikimedia.org/w/api.php); the answer shown was observed from that exact request on 2026-11-13
start_here: Say to your AI: "Search Wikimedia Commons for real photos of the Eiffel Tower at night, two results, and give me each file's title and page link." It runs tool:search-wikimedia-commons-files and hands back the file titles and canonical file-page URLs.
no_lists_because: It is a read-only search of Wikimedia Commons that takes a query and answers a page of file titles, and it keeps no list of yours.
instructions: 1. Say what real place, object or event you need a photo of, for example "Eiffel Tower at night".
2. The AI calls tools:run for tool:search-wikimedia-commons-files with {"query":"Eiffel Tower night","limit":2}. It asks Commons for File-namespace pages only (gsrnamespace 6) and downloads no media.
3. Read query.pages: each page has title (a File: title) and fullurl. Keep a candidate's title and run tool:read-wikimedia-commons-file-metadata on it to read its licence before you use it.
4. For more results, run it again with offset set to continue.gsroffset (2 in the example); stop when the answer has no continue.

worked_examples.title: Two Commons files for the Eiffel Tower at night
worked_examples.ask: Search Wikimedia Commons for real photos of the Eiffel Tower at night, two results.
worked_examples.given: Observed by sending the row's request (action=query, generator=search, gsrnamespace=6, gsrsearch=Eiffel Tower night, gsrlimit=2, gsroffset=0, prop=info, inprop=url) to commons.wikimedia.org/w/api.php on 2026-11-13. Commons results change over time, so a later run may list other files.
worked_examples.hands_back: {"batchcomplete":true,"continue":{"gsroffset":2,"continue":"gsroffset||"},"query":{"pages":[{"pageid":18143546,"ns":6,"title":"File:Reflet-tour-Eiffel-Paris-Luc-Viatour.jpg","index":2,"fullurl":"https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Reflet-tour-Eiffel-Paris-Luc-Viatour.jpg","canonicalurl":"https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Reflet-tour-Eiffel-Paris-Luc-Viatour.jpg"},{"pageid":18748369,"ns":6,"title":"File:Eiffel Tower and Pont Alexandre III at night.jpg","index":1,"fullurl":"https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Eiffel_Tower_and_Pont_Alexandre_III_at_night.jpg"}]}} (each page also carries contentmodel, pagelanguage, touched, lastrevid, length and editurl; shortened here). continue.gsroffset 2 is the offset for the next page.
